name: Alexa+
desc: Amazon's next-generation generative AI assistant for Echo and the Alexa app.
desc_zh: 亚马逊新一代生成式 AI 助手，通过 Echo 设备与 Alexa 应用使用。
solves: Old Alexa answered single questions and often misheard; Alexa+ holds a real conversation and carries multi-step tasks across apps and devices.
solves_zh: 旧版 Alexa 只能回答单个问题还常听错；Alexa+ 能真正对话，并跨应用、跨设备完成多步任务。
best_for: You are cooking and want to set a timer, reorder supplies, and check your calendar without touching a screen.
best_for_zh: 做饭时想设计时器、补货并查看日程，却不想碰屏幕的时刻。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — aboutamazon.com news and Artificial Intelligence news directories; channel A）。 Missing from the ledger. First public availability was early access in the US and Canada on 2025-02-26; general availability there followed on 2026-02-04 (CNBC). Japan launch 2026-10-28. Alexa+ is the assistant layer that also powers Alexa for Shopping, so the two entries must not be merged. Homepage is Amazon's Alexa+ storefront page; the product itself lives inside the Alexa app and on Echo hardware. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/new-alexa-generative-artificial-intelligence
